question: Which project should I view first?
answer: BITS — a Biometric Integrated Tracking System, built by a team of eight over six months. Nhovem worked on the overtime and attendance-processing layer: he built the biometric overtime check-in flow, fixed multi-shift and split-shift edge cases, and tracked down a time-normalisation bug that made overtime totals disagree with the dashboard. The team's source is public at github.com/avegabros/bits, and the active web deployment fork is at github.com/samananias/bits (deployed live at bits-beta-five.vercel.app).
